newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian civil servants to demonstrate over cuts.
newsitem.headline: Austrian civil servants to demonstrate over cuts.

text.p: Austrian civil servants said on Wednesday they would step up their campaign against job cuts and a spending freeze imposed by the government and hold a demonstration outside the Vienna finance ministry next week.

The move follows two strikes in the past two weeks by some 16,000 finance ministry and customs officials, angry at staff reductions and an erosion of salaries by cuts aimed at ensuring Austria qualifies for a single European currency.

Many Austrian civil servants who are protected from redundancy by law and relatively well-off in comparison with other public sectors in Europe, received no pay increase this year as part of the government's austerity measures.
The demonstration will take place on June 26, a spokesman for the civil servants' union said.
